name: Telegram echo bot
author: ModuForge
description: A Telegram bot that answers every message with the same text. On the first start it asks for the token from @BotFather and keeps it in its encrypted storage.

permissionReasons.FILE_SANDBOXED: Keeps the bot token and the number of the last handled message.
permissionReasons.BACKGROUND_EXECUTION: Keeps answering while the app is not on screen.
permissionReasons.NOTIFICATIONS: Tells you when the bot goes online or stops because of an error.
